title: Waiting for the next car at an EV charger
intro: Cars arrive at a highway EV charger at random, on average 3 an hour, so the rate is λ = 3/60 = 0.05 per minute and the mean time between arrivals is 1/λ = 20 minutes. The time X to the next arrival is exponential. The shaded area is P(X ≤ 15) = 1 − e^(−0.05 × 15) = 0.5276. The quantile for q = 0.5 is the median wait, ln 2 / λ = 13.86 minutes.
